name: hospital-operation-management-ecosystem
description: Hospital Operation Management Ecosystem (HOME) - A comprehensive hospital management system

scripts.predev: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000; if ($conn) { $pids = $conn | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force; Write-Host "[predev] Killed zombie process PID $_  on port 3000" } } else { Write-Host '[predev] Port 3000 is free. Starting fresh...' }"
scripts.killport: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000; if ($conn) { $pids = $conn | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force; Write-Host "Killed PID $_ on port 3000" } } else { Write-Host 'Port 3000 already free' }"
